seo.title: Homepage concept 2
seo.description: Dr. Len Tau is a dentist, author and speaker known as The Reviews Doctor. Be seen, be trusted, be chosen.

hero.kicker: Dentist, author, speaker, consultant, and key opinion leader
hero.text: I spent 23 years as a dentist and built a 4.9-star practice. Now I help dentists get seen, trusted and chosen by the patients searching for them.

proof.label: Patient reviews earned in the practice I built.

outcomes.title: More reviews. Better rankings. | More new patients.
outcomes.intro: Most dentists I meet are great clinicians. Online, patients cannot see that. They see your reviews, your rankings and your listings.

cards.title: More 5-star reviews
cards.text: A steady flow of fresh reviews, collected at checkout without adding work to your team's day.

cards.title: A higher Google ranking
cards.text: Show up in the map pack and in AI search when patients near you look for a dentist.

cards.title: More new patients
cards.text: Patients who already trust you before they call, and who choose you over the practice down the street.

cards.title: A team that owns it
cards.text: The words, the habits and the ownership, so the system runs every day without depending on you.

framework.title: Be Seen. Be Trusted. | Be Chosen.
framework.intro: Everything I teach fits into three steps. It is the system I built in my own practice, and the framework behind my new book.

steps.title: Be Seen
steps.text: Patients cannot choose a practice they cannot find. Own how you show up on Google, your listings and AI search.

steps.title: Be Trusted
steps.text: Fresh, steady reviews tell patients your practice is active and trusted. How you answer the bad ones matters just as much.

steps.title: Be Chosen
steps.text: Trust turns into calls, visits and accepted treatment when your whole team runs the system every day.

book.text: Raving Patients Supercharged walks through all three, updated for how patients search today.

proof.title: I am a dentist first.
proof.lead: I practiced dentistry for 23 years, 15 of them as a practice owner.
paragraphs: I built this system in my own practice before I ever taught it. It took us to a 4.9-star average and more than 2,000 five-star reviews.
Today I lead the dental division at Birdeye, host the Raving Patients Podcast and Supercharge, and have given more than 600 presentations worldwide.
